span.p:
Claude Code
an IdP session, and nothing else
no AWS credential on this machine

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
managed-settings.json
forceLoginMethod - forceLoginGatewayUrl
managed-only keys: MDM pushes these,
a developer cannot set them

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
fallback - the same binary, run here
127.0.0.1:8080, Homebrew postgres
switching is one URL in managed settings

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · 2 - sign in, session minted
Cognito user pool - OIDC
hosted-UI domain, authorization code flow
scopes: openid, profile, email
email_verified=true gates sign-in

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 - reaching the gateway
Tailscale tailnet - WireGuard
claude-gateway.«tailnet».ts.net
Let's Encrypt cert, issued by Tailscale
/login refuses plain HTTP off-loopback,
even on RFC1918 - this is the fix

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SSM Parameter Store - SecureString
/claude-gateway/*
OIDC issuer · client id · client secret
JWT key · Tailscale auth key
read at service start, never in user-data

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
IAM instance profile - no static keys
bedrock:InvokeModel* / Converse*
ssm:GetParameter on /claude-gateway/* only
kms:Decrypt conditioned on ssm ViaService

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
claude gateway - systemd unit
EC2 t4g.small · AL2023 arm64
«instance»
binary from the signed dnf repo, so it
cannot update itself under a demo
listen 127.0.0.1:8080
tailscaled subnet router - 172.31.0.0/20

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
postgresql 16 - local to the box
sessions, spend limits, audit
password generated on the box into
/etc/claude-gateway/pgpass (0600) - never leaves it

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 - inference · Amazon Bedrock
bedrock-runtime
us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1
us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6
us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5
the AWS default credential chain -
no key is copied anywhere

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Residency - one word
us. is the US geo profile, 10% premium
global. is the same line at list price
swapping one prefix in gateway.yaml
is the entire residency decision

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Retention - mode none
nothing written to durable storage by AWS,
nothing shared with the model provider
set and re-read on all four cells, 2026-08-23:
bedrock-runtime + bedrock-mantle,
us-east-1 + us-west-2
per region AND per control plane · proved by API

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Security group - zero inbound rules
no SSH port, no key pair, nothing exposed
administration is SSM Session Manager

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Policy, enforced server-side
availableModels + enforceAvailableModels
permissions.deny · desktop: {}
keyed on IdP group, at the managed tier
identical to GCP - the claude binary,
not the cloud

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Audit - one JSON line each
device.authorize · session.mint
managed.serve · inference
the only per-developer record - CloudTrail
sees one instance role

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
What differs at FinTechCo
Cognito to Okta or Entra - one oidc: block
single EC2 to Fargate + RDS + ALB
Tailscale MagicDNS to an internal ALB + ACM
same security properties; a single box gives
up availability, not posture
